Parish & Community Notices St. Vincent de Paul As Christmas approaches, our Local St. Vincent de Paul Conference continues to support individuals and families in our community who may be experiencing difficulties, particularly at this time of year. We would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone one who contributes so generously our monthly collection throughout the year. Your continued kindness and generosity are very much appreciated and makes a real difference to those who need a helping hand. Our Christmas collection will take Place as follows: Ballintra: 6th December St Patrick’s: 12th & 13th December Tullycorbet: 13th December Your support allows our volunteers to respond to requests for assistance and bring a little hope and comfort to families and individuals in our community. Thank you for your continued generosity and for keeping the Spirt of st.
